notes: Each eval starts by building a fresh fixture with build_fixture.sh, then runs the skill against the fork repo. Fixture lives under /tmp/claude-1000/eval-fixture-<id>/fork. The skill should treat that fork repo as cwd, identify custom commits on release/v1.0.0, build release/v1.1.0 from upstream, cherry-pick, push to the local origin, and tag v1.1.0.

evals.name: clean-update
evals.prompt: I want to update this fork from release/v1.0.0 to the new upstream release v1.1.0. Please bring my custom commits forward, push the new branch to origin, and create the tag.
evals.expected_output: Skill should: fetch both remotes, list 2 custom commits, create local release/v1.1.0 from upstream/release/v1.1.0, cherry-pick both commits cleanly, push to origin, create and push tag v1.1.0. No --force pushes. Working tree ends clean.

evals.name: conflict-update
evals.prompt: Please update this fork to release/v1.1.0 — cherry-pick my custom commits onto the new release branch.
evals.expected_output: Skill should fetch, list 2 custom commits, create local release/v1.1.0 from upstream, start cherry-picking, hit a conflict in server.go on the second commit, and surface that conflict to the user with status and explanation rather than auto-resolving or aborting. Should NOT push anything yet.
